tasks.short: Design electrical and mechanical systems for avionic instrumentation.

steps.what: Verify actual avionic instrumentation requirements, interfaces, environmental constraints and applicable design specifications
inputs: actual interface/environment specifications and design authority
outputs: checked actual avionic system design requirements

steps.what: Design actual electrical and mechanical system concepts for avionic instrumentation interfaces and installation
inputs: checked actual avionic system design requirements
actual component/interface data and installation constraints
outputs: actual chosen electrical/mechanical design decisions and rationale

steps.what: Construct actual electrical schematics and mechanical layouts using verified component libraries and chosen design
inputs: actual chosen electrical/mechanical design decisions and rationale
actual approved component symbols, dimensions and interface definitions
outputs: complete actual avionic electrical/mechanical design draft

steps.what: Check complete final design, electrical interfaces, mechanical clearances, requirements and configuration destination
inputs: complete actual avionic electrical/mechanical design draft
checked actual avionic system design requirements
actual chosen electrical/mechanical design decisions and rationale
outputs: checked final electrical/mechanical design version and actual design-record destination

steps.what: Commit exact checked avionic system design version to actual controlled design record
inputs: checked final electrical/mechanical design version and actual design-record destination
outputs: saved actual controlled design draft for required engineering review

tasks.design: Configure native approved component/symbol reuse in the electrical/mechanical CAD and controlled-design module of {OPS_SYSTEM}, with requirements in {DOCS}. Retain all instrumentation design decisions and complete electrical/mechanical verification before a separate controlled draft commit.
tasks.previous_blocker: Design construction can repeat compatible component symbols, dimensions and interface entry.
tasks.enabler_now: Native approved CAD libraries can reuse those actual verified elements.
tasks.still_hard: Avionic interfaces, installation and environmental performance require engineering judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The technician recognises when individually valid components produce an unsuitable integrated design.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated CAD construction; avionic design judgement stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native electrical/mechanical CAD libraries can reuse verified symbols and component geometry; this does not establish avionic design correctness or release authority.

assumptions: Actual requirement/interface owners and component manufacturers provide specifications; actual design-library owner validates symbol/geometry versions. Technician checks applicability and chooses every actual design decision in retained s1/s2.

S3 reduces compatible symbol/geometry and repeated interface entry only; new connections, placements, calculations and integration reasoning remain. S4 retains full requirement/interface/clearance and omission checks; any actual engineering test is retained, never replaced by a successful file import.

S5 saves a controlled design draft, not manufacturing release, installation or airworthiness approval. Any actual independent engineering review and later release must bind its exact final version before a separate gated action. No new safety/certification claim is made.
Shares are provisional, not measured. Native libraries first; existing CAD reuse/runtime earns zero new saving. Commit retains one percent using existing checking without added approval work.
unknowns: Which compatible CAD elements are currently reconstructed manually?
research_questions: Can approved-library reuse reduce construction after complete integrated design checks?

incremental.description: Maintain actual approved component/library versions and interface applicability checks.

approvals.approved_version: s4 exact checked electrical/mechanical design version and actual controlled-draft destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 30*0.30 repeated compatible CAD construction = 9; minus 1 upkeep = 8. Half eligible gives 4.5 minus 1 = 3.5. Requirements, design decisions, new integration, full verification and commit retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Aerospace technicians retain avionic system judgement while actual repeated CAD elements may shrink.
role.ambitious_version: Measure actual manual CAD reconstruction while retaining all engineering verification and release responsibility.

job.title: Aerospace Engineering and Operations Technologists and Technicians
